messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price to 0.06, over our 0.04 per-purchase cap, and Purser refused the last purchase. I've moved buying to Ridgeline (0.03, 0.04 margin, data 15 min old, 6 of last 20 unavailable). If the CFO wants Stockline's live data back, we need the per-purchase cap raised to at least 0.06 for the Stockline payments. Northgate Stock (0.03, x402) is not on our approved supplier list, so I have not used it.

The CFO now has a rebalance (P-0001/P-0002). Both options raise your per-purchase cap to 0.06 and your budget to 12.00, so you could use Stockline again. Option A keeps the query price at 0.07, which leaves a 0.01 margin. Option B, which I recommended, raises it to 0.10 for a 0.04 margin. Keep using Ridgeline until the CFO signs. Don't use Northgate: it's still not on the approved supplier list.
